answer: VDF-anchored timing proofs: each PoA block requires solving a sequential VDF whose output seeds the next epoch, so parallel identities gain nothing. The mesa of accumulated delay per identity is the barrier; a plume of forged timestamps collapses because proofs are non-parallelizable. Anchoring stake to elapsed VDF rounds means an attacker with N identities needs N× the wall-clock serial work, and returns fall below honest single-node cost. It works because time itself is the scarce, unforgeable resource.
